links.outcome: Unsolicited clinical monologues, diagnoses and medication advice with vs without KG governance
links.effect: Ungoverned model produced unsolicited clinical monologues on 100% of turns vs 9% governed; delivered diagnoses and medication advice the governed system never produced.
links.quote: Stripped of governance, the same model produced unsolicited clinical monologues on 100% of turns (vs 9% governed) and delivered diagnoses and medication advice the governed system never produced.

links.outcome: Crisis detection sensitivity/specificity on adversarial probes and external dialogues
links.effect: Adversarial sensitivity 96.7%, specificity 95.4% (277 probes); detected 98.5% of 600 external dialogues with ongoing suicidal ideation or self-harm at or before the annotator confirming turn.
links.quote: Adversarial crisis-detection sensitivity was 96.7% and specificity 95.4% (277 probes); on external validation, the system detected 98.5% of 600 dialogues with ongoing suicidal ideation or self-harm at or before the annotator confirming turn.

links.outcome: Detection of high-risk presentations and hard-halt escalation
links.effect: KG detected all 18 high-risk presentations, firing a therapy-suppressing hard halt on 16/18.
links.quote: The KG routed 116/117 vignettes (99.1%) to guideline-appropriate care and detected all 18 high-risk presentations, firing a therapy-suppressing hard halt on 16/18.

links.outcome: Repeatability of KG decisions across repeated runs
links.effect: Decisions were 99.1% repeatable, 100% reconstructable per turn, and 100% provenance-auditable across all 354 KG nodes.
links.quote: Decisions were 99.1% repeatable, 100% reconstructable per turn, and 100% provenance-auditable across all 354 KG nodes.
